authoredSolutions.1: The kinetic energies are equal, and \(K=\frac{p^{2}}{2m}\) gives \(p=\sqrt{2mK}\), so \(p\propto\sqrt{m}\). With masses \(0.4\text{ }kg,\ 1.2\text{ }kg,\ 1.6\text{ }kg\), \[p_{A}:p_{B}:p_{C}=\sqrt{0.4}:\sqrt{1.2}:\sqrt{1.6}=\sqrt{4}:\sqrt{12}:\sqrt{16}=2:2\sqrt{3}:4=1:\sqrt{3}:2\] The correct choice is A.
authoredSolutions.2: For a non-reflecting (fully absorbing) surface at normal incidence the radiation pressure is \(\frac{I}{c}\), and this equals \(\frac{F}{A}\). Here \(I=360\text{ }W/cm^{2}=3.6\times10^{6}\text{ }W/m^{2}\), so \[\frac{F}{A}=\frac{3.6\times10^{6}}{3\times10^{8}}=1.2\times10^{-2}\text{ }N/m^{2}\] With \(F=2.4\times10^{-4}\text{ }N\), \[A=\frac{2.4\times10^{-4}}{1.2\times10^{-2}}=2\times10^{-2}\text{ }m^{2}=0.02\text{ }m^{2}\] The correct choice is B. The stated duration of 1 hour 30 minutes plays no part, since force and flux are both instantaneous quantities.
authoredSolutions.3: Equal de Broglie wavelength means equal momentum, \(p=\frac{h}{\lambda}\). Since \(K=\frac{p^{2}}{2m}\), for a common \(p\) we get \(K\propto\frac{1}{m}\).
